description: Hand-labelled probe on data/VERIFIN_sample_financial_report.pdf (Northstar Technologies, a synthetic table-heavy report). Labels were checked against the figures on pages 2-7 by reading them, not produced by a model. 'mgmt_summary' claims are the report's own Section 6 highlights, several of which contradict its financial statements by design.
